# claude-plugins

> Claude Code plugin marketplace for Hermes Labs: a single manifest that lets
> `claude` install any of seven independently maintained Hermes Labs plugins
> by name, from their own source repos.

This repo holds only the marketplace manifest
(`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`). It does not contain any plugin's code —
each plugin lives in, and is versioned by, its own repository, and Claude Code
fetches it from there at install time.

## Add the marketplace

```
/plugin marketplace add hermes-labs-ai/claude-plugins
```

Then install a plugin by name:

```
/plugin install little-canary@hermes-labs
```

`/plugin marketplace update hermes-labs` refreshes the manifest from `main`.

## Plugins

- `hermes-blind` — local recovery anchors for a Claude Code or Codex session,
  plus evidence-gated evaluation prompts for picking a session back up
  without trusting its own self-report.
  https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind
- `lintlang` — runs LintLang after Claude Code edits a supported
  prompt/config file and returns concise repair guidance for what it finds.
  https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/lintlang
- `rule-audit` — on-demand static analysis of an AI system prompt or
  AGENTS.md for contradictions, coverage gaps, priority ambiguities, and
  meta-paradoxes.
  https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/rule-audit
- `hermeneutic-gate` — legacy advisory Stop-hook bundle for the fixed
  English gate; not certified against current Claude Stop behavior in
  v0.1.7, so prefer the `hermeneutic` CLI directly.
  https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/hermeneutic
- `little-canary` — blocks a Claude Code turn when a local Little Canary
  server rejects the submitted prompt.
  https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/little-canary
- `claude-trash-guard` — blocks permanent-delete shell commands (`rm -rf`
  and friends) and redirects the agent to a recoverable trash workflow
  instead.
  https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-trash-guard
- `agent-signage` — a `PreToolUse` hook that reports when the file you're
  about to touch sits in a git checkout that's behind its upstream, and
  stays silent otherwise.
  https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-signage

## Do not use this repo as

- a source of plugin code — it ships none; every install pulls from the
  plugin's own repo
- proof that a listed plugin is actively maintained or certified for the
  current Claude Code release (see `hermeneutic-gate` above for a plugin
  that explicitly is not)
- a general Claude Code plugin registry — it lists only plugins Hermes Labs
  itself built and maintains

## About Hermes Labs

Hermes Labs is an independent AI-reliability lab building open-source tools
that catch silent failure modes in production AI. More at
[hermes-labs.ai](https://hermes-labs.ai).
